decisions.reason: As a flagship product line very close to the core practice software, it benefits from strong related knowledge, customer feedback loops, and the firm's own R&D, so we can keep improving it rather than withdraw it.

The education institute builds on our established training and practitioner-facing capabilities, making it sufficiently related to our knowledge base to justify continued development and commercial use.
The analytics dashboard uses data, workflow, and integration knowledge already embedded in our software business, so our absorptive capacity for refining it is high despite some adoption uncertainty.
A complete dental practice bundle is very close to our established offer and strengthens the commercial packaging of what we already know how to build, support, and update.

The job and practice listing portal is relatively distant from our core software and support competences, so learning advantages and improvement potential are weaker and resources are better redeployed to more related products.
